title: Length of a String
description:
A C string ends with the special character `'\0'`. Count characters with a loop until you reach it (do not use `strlen`).

Input: The input is a single word (no spaces).
Output: One integer, the number of characters.

title: Reverse a String
description:
Print the characters of the string in reverse order. Loop from the last index down to 0.

Input: The input is a single word (no spaces).
Output: The reversed word.

title: Palindrome Check
description:
A palindrome reads the same forwards and backwards. Compare the first character with the last, the second with the second last, and so on. Letters are compared exactly (case-sensitive).

Input: The input is a single word (no spaces).
Output: Print `Palindrome` or `Not Palindrome`.

title: Count Vowels and Consonants
description:
Vowels are `a e i o u` (either case). Every other letter is a consonant. Ignore anything that is not a letter.

Input: The input is one line that may contain spaces. It contains letters, spaces and punctuation.
Output: One line: the vowel count and the consonant count separated by a space.

title: Convert to Uppercase
description:
Turn every lowercase letter into uppercase and leave all other characters unchanged. In ASCII, a lowercase letter minus 32 gives the uppercase letter (or use `toupper`).

Input: The input is one line that may contain spaces.
Output: The converted line.

title: Toggle Case
description:
Change uppercase letters to lowercase and lowercase letters to uppercase. Other characters stay the same.

Input: The input is one line that may contain spaces.
Output: The line with every letter's case flipped.

title: Letters, Digits and Others
description:
Classify every character of the line as a letter, a digit, or something else (spaces and symbols).

Input: The input is one line that may contain spaces.
Output: One line: `letters digits others`, three integers separated by single spaces.

title: Remove All Spaces
description:
Copy only the non-space characters to the output. Keep a separate write index.

Input: The input is one line that may contain spaces. It has at least one non-space character.
Output: The line with all spaces removed.

title: Count a Given Character
description:
Count how many times a given character appears in a line (case-sensitive).

Input: The first line is the text (may contain spaces). The second line has one character `ch`.
Output: One integer, the number of occurrences of `ch`.

title: Join Two Words
description:
Combine two words into one by appending the second to the first (you may use `strcat`). Make sure the destination array is large enough.

Input: Two words separated by whitespace.
Output: The first word immediately followed by the second, then a space-free newline.

title: Count Words
description:
Words are separated by single spaces. Count how many words the sentence has. Hint: count the positions where a non-space character starts a word.

Input: The input is one line that may contain spaces. No leading, trailing or repeated spaces.
Output: One integer, the number of words.

title: Letter Frequency
description:
Count how often each lowercase letter `a`-`z` appears (ignore case: treat `A` as `a`). An array of 26 counters indexed by `ch - 'a'` works well.

Input: The input is one line that may contain spaces.
Output: For every letter that appears at least once, in alphabetical order, print a line `letter count`.

title: Anagram Check
description:
Two words are anagrams if they use exactly the same letters the same number of times, in any order (case-sensitive here).

Input: Two words separated by whitespace, each made of lowercase letters.
Output: Print `Anagrams` or `Not Anagrams`.

title: Remove Duplicate Characters
description:
Keep only the first occurrence of each character and drop later repeats, preserving the original order.

Input: The input is a single word (no spaces).
Output: The word without repeated characters.

title: Longest Word in a Sentence
description:
Find the longest word in a sentence. If several words tie, print the first one.

Input: The input is one line that may contain spaces. Words are separated by single spaces.
Output: The longest word.

title: Capitalize Each Word
description:
Make the first letter of every word uppercase and all other letters lowercase.

Input: The input is one line that may contain spaces. Words are separated by single spaces and contain only letters.
Output: The converted sentence.

title: Run-Length Compression
description:
Replace each group of identical consecutive characters by the character followed by the group length. Example: `aaabcc` becomes `a3b1c2`.

Input: The input is a single word (no spaces). It contains only letters.
Output: The compressed string.

title: Longest Palindromic Substring
description:
Find the longest contiguous part of the word that is a palindrome. If several have the same length, choose the one that starts earliest. Hint: expand outwards from every possible centre (both single-character and between-character centres).

Input: The input is a single word (no spaces).
Output: The longest palindromic substring.

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description:
Find the length of the longest contiguous part of the word in which no character appears twice. Hint: keep a window `[start, i]` and the last seen index of each character; when a repeat is found inside the window, move `start` past the earlier copy.

Input: The input is a single word (no spaces).
Output: One integer, the length of that longest substring.

title: Run-Length Decompression
description:
The input is a compressed string made of letters each followed by a count (the count may have several digits). Expand it: `a3b12` becomes `aaabbbbbbbbbbbb`. Hint: after a letter, build the number digit by digit with `n = n * 10 + digit`.

Input: The input is a single word (no spaces). Every letter is followed by a count of at least 1.
Output: The expanded string.
constraints: The expanded string has at most 200 characters
